input.notes: Initial term 1 year (July 1, 2027 - June 30, 2028) plus up to four 1-year renewals, maximum 5 years through June 30, 2032 (Section 1.2). Evening production cleaning; schools cleaned M-F on ~184 days/yr (180 student + 4 non-student days); Administrative Service Center M-F year-round (~250 days); Transportation and Maintenance Facility M/W/F year-round (Section 2.4). Summer deep clean of every school; summer school daily cleaning M-Th at Glacier View ES and Cedar Prairie HS (July 6-29, 2027). Washington prevailing wage, Janitors trade, King County (Section 3.4). Grounds, kitchens/serveries, stadium and aquatic center excluded (Section 2.8). District furnishes paper products, hand soap and liners. Climate zone inferred from King County, WA location; not stated in the RFP.

input.summary: Cedar Prairie School District No. 427, RFP No. 27-02 District-Wide Custodial Services (1-year base + four 1-year renewals). Exhibit A (19 locations) registered: 17 school sites + Administrative Service Center (901) + Transportation and Maintenance Facility (902). Addendum No. 1 applied: Old Mill ES (208) deleted_by_amendment; Riverbend ES (209) priced with 6 portables (Pricing Area 57,824 SF); ASC (901) revised to 22,960 SF. Gross = Exhibit A Column (9) Permanent Building SF; cleanable = Exhibit B Pricing Area (Column 9 + portable classrooms; 902 cleanable 6,850 SF only). Schools M-F ~184 days + summer deep clean (floor care); 901 M-F year-round; 902 M/W/F year-round. Incumbent Sound & Summit Building Care, LLC (CPSD-C-22-031), $3,412,860 paid for 2025-26; $12,904,115 over 48 months. No grounds or dining scope.

Revised Exhibit B total pricing area 1,499,949 SF.

Cleanable area exceeds gross at schools with portable classrooms (201, 203, 205, 206, 207, 209, 211, 301, 303, 401, 501) by design: Column (9) excludes portables and the Exhibit B Pricing Area (recorded as cleanable) adds them (Section 2.3, Note 2, A1). Portables are not separately numbered buildings; counts and unit sizes are in notes. Portable counts may change during the term (Section 2.7).

Buildings mentioned in text but absent from the exhibits and excluded from scope: restroom and concession buildings at Cedar Prairie Memorial Stadium and the District Aquatic Center (Section 2.8(d), A8). No numbers or areas given; not registered.
Grounds maintenance is not part of this RFP (Section 2.8(b)); Exhibit A Column (7) site acreage (270.1 acres total) is information only, so no grounds areas were registered.
Restroom fixture counts and floor finish mix are not given; gym wood floor SF (Column 11) recorded in notes only. Climate zone inferred from King County, WA location.
